title: DeviceRegistration
description: Push notification device registration record stored per user per device.

platform.description: Push platform: apns for iOS/macOS, fcm for Android.

token.description: Current APNs device token or FCM registration token.

userId.description: Cognito sub (UUID) that owns this device registration.

registeredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the device was first registered.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent token update.
